publication_year_note: Copyright page (PDF p. 4) and chapter headers (PDF pp. 19, 47) print © Springer Nature Singapore Pte Ltd. 2022; no separate online-first year is printed.
rationale: This is a 318-page Springer book monograph published in 2022 based on a survey of 3,714 households across four Indian cities (Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Kochi). However, the provided full-text extract is truncated at PDF Page 68 of 318 (book p. 50, mid-Chapter 2), before Chapter 4 (Methodology and Research Sites, p. 85) and all primary empirical chapters (Chapters 6-8, pp. 159-286). Notably, the List of Tables (PDF pp. 17-18) shows inferential statistical tables in the truncated portion—specifically correlations in Tables 6.28 and 7.14 and one-way ANOVA comparisons across three institutional types of urban water utilities (public municipal department, autonomous water board, etc.) on water supply efficiency, effectiveness, satisfaction, and overall performance in Tables 8.5-8.19 (pp. 269-283). Because the text is truncated before methods and results, it cannot be verified from the accessible pages whether Chapter 8's institutional ANOVA contrasts test a SWiM-eligible household service access outcome (Family A/C) or composite perception/utility scores, nor can any printed estimates, F-statistics, or p-values be extracted. Per audit instructions for texts truncated before methods/results, quant_verdict is set to cannot_tell.
